newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Pacific, Newmont set merger vote.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Pacific, Newmont set merger vote.

text.p: Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp and Newmont Mining Corp said Friday they have set May 5 as the date for the vote by their shareholders on the proposed merger of the two companies.

Santa Fe will hold a special shareholder meeting in Albuquerque, N.M., at the Albuquerque Marriott Hotel at 10 a.m. MST on that day. Newmont and its subsidiary, Newmont Gold Co, will hold their annual meetings at 11:30 a.m. and 12:00 noon, MST, at the Forum in Denver on the same day.

If the merger is approved, the combined company will be the largest gold company in North America, with proven and probable reserves of 55 million ounces and gold production of four million ounces by 1998, they said.
